fields.label: API Token
fields.description: Your e-Boekhouden API token from account settings

fields.label: Source Application
fields.description: Application name for API requests (no spaces or special characters)

fields.label: Payment Gateway Adjustment Detection
fields.description: Configure detection of internal payment gateway adjustments (e.g., Mollie fee corrections) that should be skipped during import

fields.label: Virtual Account
fields.description: Select the ERPNext account for the payment gateway's virtual account (e.g., '10460 - Mollie - NVV'). Leave empty to disable adjustment detection.

fields.label: Gateway Invoice Prefix
fields.description: Invoice number prefix for gateway invoices (e.g., 'MOL-NL-R' for Mollie). Adjustments for invoices with this prefix will be skipped.

fields.label: Automatic Party Creation
fields.description: Configure automatic creation of Customers/Suppliers from bank transaction data

fields.label: Auto-create Customers/Suppliers from Bank Transactions
fields.description: When enabled, automatically creates new Customer or Supplier records from bank transaction party names if no match is found. Uses IBAN-based matching and fuzzy name matching to avoid duplicates. Disable for manual party management.

fields.label: Account Group Mappings
fields.description: Configure account group codes and names for Chart of Accounts import

fields.label: Balance Sheet Group Mappings
fields.description:
Balance sheet account groups in format: 'code name' (one per line).
Example:
001 Vaste activa
002 Liquide middelen
004 Vorderingen
006 Schulden

fields.label: P&L Group Mappings
fields.description:
Profit & Loss account groups in format: 'code name' (one per line).
Example:
055 Opbrengsten
056 Personeelskosten
057 Overige kosten

fields.label: Account Group Type Mappings
fields.description: Map account groups to ERPNext account types for accurate classification during import. Click 'Parse & Suggest Types' to auto-populate from the group mappings above.

fields.label: Parse & Suggest Types
fields.description: Analyze the group mappings above and suggest account types based on group names and codes

fields.label: Group Type Mappings
fields.description: Configure the ERPNext account type for each account group. Used by the classification service to assign correct account types during import.

fields.label: Balance Sheet Organization
fields.description: Customize names for balance sheet group accounts. Leave empty to use defaults.

fields.label: Rebuild Account Tree
fields.description: Reorganize accounts under configured groups (Vorderingen, Financial Accounts, Overlopende activa, Schulden, Belastingen) based on current settings

fields.label: Receivables Group Name
fields.description: Name for the receivables/debtors group account

fields.label: Payables Group Name
fields.description: Name for the payables/creditors group account

fields.label: Financial Accounts Group Name
fields.description: Name for the financial accounts group (bank + cash accounts)

fields.label: Prepaid/Accrued Assets Group Name
fields.description: Name for the overlopende activa (prepaid/accrued assets) group account

fields.label: Tax Payable Group Name
fields.description: Name for the tax payable group account

fields.label: Tax Receivable Group Name
fields.description: Name for the tax receivable group account

fields.label: Account Classification Configuration
fields.description: Configure how accounts are classified during import. You can use account code ranges and keywords to control classification of BAL (Balance Sheet) and VW (P&L) accounts.

fields.label: Use Advanced Classification Service
fields.description: Enable the AccountClassificationService for more accurate classification using categories, groups, and patterns

fields.label: Classification Strategy
fields.options:
Prefer Groups
Prefer Code Ranges
Groups Only
Code Ranges Only
fields.description: Choose whether to prioritize E-Boekhouden groups or account code ranges for classification

fields.label: BAL (Balance Sheet) Classification Rules
fields.description: Configure account code ranges for Balance Sheet accounts. Use ranges like '0000-2999' for Assets, '3000-4999' for Liabilities. Leave empty to disable code-based classification.

fields.label: Asset Account Ranges
fields.description:
Account code ranges for Assets (one per line). Leave empty to disable range-based classification. Example based on administratievoeren.nl schema:
0010-0599 Fixed Assets
1000-1199 Liquid Assets
1300-1899 Receivables
2000-2999 Transfer accounts
3000-3199 Inventory

fields.label: Liability Account Ranges
fields.description:
Account code ranges for Liabilities (one per line). Leave empty to disable range-based classification. Example based on administratievoeren.nl schema:
0800-0899 Provisions
0900-0999 Long-term debt
1600-1699 Creditors

fields.label: Equity Account Ranges
fields.description:
Account code ranges for Equity (one per line). Leave empty to disable range-based classification. Example based on administratievoeren.nl schema:
0600-0699 Equity accounts

fields.label: Equity Keywords
fields.description: Keywords to identify Equity accounts (one per line). Leave empty to disable keyword-based classification.

fields.label: VW (Profit & Loss) Classification Rules
fields.description: Configure account code ranges for P&L accounts. Use ranges like '8000-8999' for Income, '6000-7999' for Expenses. Leave empty to rely on groups only.

fields.label: Income Account Ranges
fields.description:
Account code ranges for Income (one per line). Leave empty to rely on groups and keywords only. Example based on administratievoeren.nl schema:
8000-8099 Revenue/Sales (Omzet)
9000-9099 Results from participations
9800-9899 Payment discounts

fields.label: Expense Account Ranges
fields.description:
Account code ranges for Expenses (one per line). Leave empty to rely on groups and keywords only. Example based on administratievoeren.nl schema:
4000-4999 All expense categories
5000-5999 Additional expense accounts
7000-7099 Cost of goods sold

fields.label: Income Keywords
fields.description: Keywords to identify Income accounts (one per line). Leave empty to disable keyword-based classification.

fields.label: Expense Keywords
fields.description: Keywords to identify Expense accounts (one per line). Leave empty to disable keyword-based classification.

fields.label: Cost Center Configuration
fields.description: Configure which account groups should be created as cost centers in ERPNext

fields.label: Parse Groups & Configure Cost Centers
fields.description: Click to analyze the account groups above and configure cost center creation

fields.label: Cost Center Mappings
fields.description: Configure which account groups should become cost centers
